essence: The ritual requires drawing an outer ten-petaled lotus and writing within its filaments.
The prescribed mantra for Vāsudeva ends with phaṭ and svāhā and has the stated syllable count.
After the prior step, the practitioner should construct an earth-house marked by Madana.
The ritual object should be properly made into a pill on a gold plate and worshipped.
The Gopāla yantra is to be held in the hand by meritorious persons.
